privacy.text: Last updated: May 2025
1. Overview

Ekamuthu Admin ("the App") is an internal management tool for authorised court administrators of the Ekamuthu platform. This policy explains what information the App accesses, how it is used, and how it is protected.
2. Information We Collect

The App accesses your name, email address, and administrator role as stored in your Ekamuthu account. No information is collected that you have not already provided when your account was created by a system administrator.
The browser app stores a short-lived access token in session storage. A refresh token is stored in an HTTP-only cookie. Signing out clears the browser session and revokes the refresh cookie.
If you grant notification permission, a push notification token is registered with the Ekamuthu server so that you receive alerts about game events at your courts.
3. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used solely to authenticate your identity, display your admin profile, scope the data shown to the courts you manage, and deliver push notifications for relevant game events. It is never used for advertising or profiling.
4. Third-Party Services

The App communicates only with the Ekamuthu backend API operated by your organisation. It contains no analytics SDKs, advertising networks, crash-reporting services, or other third-party data processors.
Browser notifications use the browser’s push service. A subscription endpoint and encryption keys are stored on the server to deliver relevant venue notifications.
5. Data Retention

Authentication tokens stored on your device are removed when you sign out or when the token is invalidated. Server-side account data is retained and managed by your organisation's system administrator in accordance with your organisation's own data retention policy.
6. Security
Production communication uses HTTPS. Private API responses are not stored by the offline service worker.
7. Children
The App is intended for use by adult employees and contractors in an administrative capacity. It is not directed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect information from minors.
8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. Continued use of the App following any update constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
9. Contact
For questions about this privacy policy or your data, contact us at support@strangercourt.com.
